translations.web: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
translations.bsb: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
translations.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
